author: root

silhouette.reason: All12 native poses now read as a compact capped child: hat and cheek width anchor a short connected torso and dressed hips; the long adult calf columns of v4 are gone. Rear hair contour still has a straight segment.

anatomy.reason: Face now occupies18..22 with temple/ear/cheek shadow and short connected chin/collar; shoulder24 and hips27 preserve dense reference-scale anatomy. Profile eye and cheek are separated from cap and hair, without the former hooked mouth bar. The far cheek remains economical.

walking.reason: All four decoded phases alternate a planted lower sole with the raised opposite shoe; hands swing opposite supporting legs. Profile gray cuff stays on the arm joint and forward hand slopes down. Near/far idle shoe overlap remains stiff but has distinct toe and heel boundaries.

pixelCraft.reason: Native15-color clusters have a darker navy contour, warmer cheek shading, continuous tapered hair highlight and compact red-toe/dark-sole overlap. Cream collar/undershirt and blue vest form connected planes; the rear pack and cap highlights remain simple flat planes compared with references.

identity.reason: Red cap with cream brim, navy hair, cream shirt under blue vest and gold-brown/red-pocket backpack remain consistent across all12 poses. Profile backpack attaches behind the shoulder and rear view; pocket depth could use stronger asymmetry.

directionContinuity.reason: Front/back/profile preserve cap height, compact hip/sole baseline and wardrobe identity. Mirrored profiles keep the same pack and hand layering. Nape silhouette translates coherently though rear hair is still a broad plane.

loop.reason: Exact native GIF uses stepA-idle-stepB-idle, four140ms frames, repeating idle and intentional1px bob. Actual browser samples observe all3 distinct source poses at1x and4x without pixel changes or playback errors.

limitations: Manual aesthetic judgment, not proof of original-game quality or user acceptance.
Simple cap highlight/rearpack planes and stiff idle profile shoes remain.
